title: CropSCOUT spray estimate rules
notice: HACKATHON PLACEHOLDER RATES. The dose_ml values are illustrative defaults for a hand sprayer, not label rates. Before any real use, replace them with the registered label rate of the actual product for tomato in your region, and keep the agronomist confirmation step. A spray estimate is shown only when the condition passed every CropSCOUT safeguard. Healthy leaves and non-infectious disorders get no spray.

units.dose: mL of mixed spray per plant
units.max_dose_note: 100 % spray = max_dose_ml (the largest dose_ml x the top multiplier: late blight 40 mL x 1.5). percent = dose / max_dose_ml.
units.pump_note: pump_ml_per_second converts the dose into a sprayer run time; measure your pump and change it.

severity.method: share of leaf pixels that look like lesions (yellow, orange, brown or dark necrotic) and lie next to leaf tissue, in the analysed 224 px square; see docs/spray-estimate.md
severity.calibration: thresholds chosen on data/processed/classifier/val with live/eval_severity.py: healthy vs lesion-disease AUC 0.87, 19% of healthy leaves above 10% lesion area, 2% of leaves unmeasurable

multiplier.note: dose = dose_ml x (min + (max - min) x clamp(lesion_fraction / full_at, 0, 1)); unknown severity uses 1.0

actions.spray: Spray the estimated dose on this plant.
actions.remove: Do not spray this plant; remove it. Spraying does not cure a virus.

default.reason: No rule for this condition, so no spray is estimated.

Tomato_leaf_late_blight.note: Urgent: also treat neighbouring plants that still look clean.

Tomato_leaf_leaf_mold.note: Ventilation and lower humidity matter as much as the spray.

Tomato_leaf_bacterial_spot.note: Copper protects clean tissue only; it does not cure existing spots.

Tomato_leaf_two_spotted_spider_mite.note: Cover the undersides of the leaves.

Tomato_leaf_pest_damage.note: Confirm live mites with a hand lens first.

Tomato_leaf_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.reason: Virus: no spray cures it. Remove the plant and control whiteflies separately.

Tomato_leaf_tomato_mosaic_virus.reason: Virus: no spray cures it. Remove the plant and disinfect tools.

Tomato_leaf_mosaic_virus.reason: Virus: no spray cures it. Remove the plant and disinfect tools.

Tomato_fruit_spotted_wilt_virus.reason: Virus: no spray cures it. Remove the plant and control thrips separately.

Tomato_fruit_blossom_end_rot.reason: Not an infection (calcium and watering). Spraying does not help.

Tomato_fruit_catfacing.reason: Not an infection (flower damage). Spraying does not help.

Tomato_fruit_fruit_cracking.reason: Not an infection (uneven watering). Spraying does not help.
